what_happened: Scene: layout 9, dark-blue cabinets; pan_6 (dark pan, wooden handle with metal ferrule) on a high open shelf/upper cabinet (z=1.45) left of the robot, target front_center burner 2.28 m away; fish on a plate 2.95 m from the burner. Stage 0: the gripper reached up to the pan's handle end at 60-112 (pan touch 63-111, pushes only; wrist shows the handle lying at/just below finger level, not between the fingers) and closed at 115 on air (width 0.002); the handle ends up under the gripper (zoom 116-128). It backed off, re-opened at ~288, came back to the handle end at 340-372 and closed on air again at 375 (no pan contact). From 392 to 2848 the fingers stayed closed and the arm hovered 15-40 cm in front of/below the pan (wrist keeps the pan in view at 500, 1400, 2060, 2860), with two more closes on air (879, 2065) and no further pan contact until a brush at 2895. The pan never moved (end 2.29 m from the burner); stages 1-2 never started.
causal_chain: approached the end of the pan handle from below/in front at ~60 -> closed on air at 115 (handle below the fingers) -> second close on air at 375 -> fingers kept closed and arm hovered near the pan 392-2848 (~2450 steps) -> pan never left the cabinet -> timeout at 2900
self_recovery: One re-try (re-opened ~288, closed on air again at 375). After that the gripper stayed closed and the policy only hovered; no further real attempt.

packet_facts: pan touch 63-111 (16 short intervals), then only 2895-2899
pan holds: none; pan end dist 2.29 m (unchanged)

uncertain_about: Exact finger-handle geometry at 115 (the handle seems to pass under the closing fingers); why the policy kept the fingers closed while hovering.
